title: Structured exactly-one event likelihood zero-training readiness
purpose: Verify that the V2 episode objective directly penalizes duplicate commit peaks and is causal, invariant, stable and differentiable before any retraining.

approval.scope: One immutable zero-training C01-C08 exact-one loss readiness; zero C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly delegated best-method choices and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 relational raw-token cache and causal episode arrays.
Three sealed unified learned-geometry observation arrays.
Sealed V1 training FAIL and commit-policy feasibility FAIL evidence.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and locally trained frozen outputs.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Read population arrays for exact counts and use one deterministic episode-preserving 128-row fit batch for an untrained forward/backward.

teacher.source: Corrected causal junction/terminal class and compact episode membership.
teacher.student_input: Unchanged 240101-parameter relational model input; episode ID is consumed only by the structured loss after forward.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Positive likelihood requires one correct structural commit and zero other structural commits in the complete episode.

split.fit: C01-C06 supplies one deterministic real readiness batch; optimizer steps are zero.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: None; random seed is readiness-only and no checkpoint is written.
split.historical_pollution_audit: V1 and state-machine FAILs are bound only as causal justification; their predictions are not optimized in readiness.

methods.main: Parameter-free log-space likelihood of zero structural commits for corridor rows and exactly one correct-class commit with zero other commits for each complete positive episode.
methods.baseline: V1 max-MIL, whose gradient on a non-maximum duplicate positive peak is exactly zero.
methods.fallback: Any ordering, permutation, numerical, complete-batch or gradient failure stops the V2 objective before training.

acceptance.population: Exactly 188126 observations, 142184/45942 split, unchanged 240101-parameter model and one complete 128-row fit batch.
acceptance.semantics: One correct peak has lower loss than zero, two correct or one wrong-class peak; old duplicate gradient=0 and exact-one duplicate gradient>0.001.
acceptance.numerics: Episode permutation error<=1e-6, extreme logits finite and real complete-episode loss/backward finite.
acceptance.system: Zero optimizer/trained inference/checkpoint/threshold/C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner; source unchanged and complete figure/log/seal.

failure_policy: Any source, population, loss ordering, gradient, permutation, numerical, real-batch or isolation failure seals FAIL and stops V2 training.
retention: Retain synthetic and real loss evidence, gradient attribution, gates, paper figure/source, log, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU full population contract plus one 128-row untrained forward/backward
